prompt: Many people spend too much time using social media. What problems can this cause, and what solutions can you suggest?
essay:
Nowadays, many people spend too much time using social media. I believe that it causes a lot of problems, such as eye infections and psychological diseases.  This is because it takes us away from reality. Therefore, I can suggest several solutions, including monitoring and setting limits.

On the one hand, spending too much time on social media can cause various eye problems, including eye infections and irritation. This is because screen emissions affect the eyes with long-term use. For example, in 2025, I went to an ophthalmologist because my eyes were red and itchy, and he advised me to wear blue-light-blocking glasses and not use social media for more than half an hour at a time. Therefore, I suggest an arrangement not to use social media more than three times a week, with an alarm set every half hour.

On the other hand, long use of social media is linked to some psychological diseases, including depression and Autism. In other words, they happen because of a loss of communication skills and poor analytical ability. For instance, one of my relatives spends a lot of time on social media, and his ability to express himself correctly has declined; in addition, he likes to stay alone. As a result, it creates a big gap in people's abilities. My suggestion is to get together with others to minimise the risks, especially by monitoring each other.

In conclusion, both sides present the causes and suggestions for too much social media use to address this important issue. Therefore, I believe we must be more organised and manage our social media use.
